The President, on the advice of the Prime Minister has been pleased to appoint the following persons to be the member of the Council of Ministers
The President has been pleased to appoint Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee to be the Prime Minister with effect from 1030 hours of the 13th October 1999
Ministry of Shipping, Road Transport and Highways
The Central Govt. entrusts the additional charge of the post of Chairman Visakhapatnam Port Trust to Shri N. Dhanaraju Deputy Chairman, Visakhapatnam Port Trust
The President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri Kirit N. Rawal, Additional Solicitor General of India with effect from the date of assumption of charge
The President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri R.N. Trivedi, Additional Solicitor General of India with effect from the date of assumption of charge
The President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri Altaf Ahmed, Additional Solicitor General of India with effect from the date of assumption of charge
The President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri Soli J. Sorabjee, Attorney General for India with effect from the date of assumption of charge
The President is pleased to accept the resignation of Shri C.S. Vaidyanathan as Additional Solicitor General of India with effect from 21st October, 1999 A.N.
Shri Nitish Kumar has with effect from 5th August, 1999 ceased to be Minister in the Council of Ministers
Ministry of Shipping, Road Transport and Highways
In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Major Port Trusts Act. 1963 (38 of 1963)
The President is pleased to appoint Shri Srichand Bhagwandas Jaisinghani, Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India
The President is pleased to appoint Jaising Shri Srichand Bhagwandas hani, Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India for Delhi High Court
